Next.js App Router + PostgreSQL + pgvector

Car Recommendation DBMS Backend API

Robust, SQL-injection-safe backend API layer with 1536-dimensional vector similarity search, multi-table joins, and admin DML routes.

POST/api/recommend

Hybrid pgvector cosine search + SQL multi-attribute filtering (Price, Fuel, Transmission, Safety)

Sample Request / Payload
{
  "prompt": "5-star safe compact SUV with panoramic sunroof",
  "minPrice": 800000,
  "maxPrice": 2000000,
  "fuelType": "Petrol",
  "transmission": "DCT",
  "minSafety": 4.5
}
GET/api/compare?ids=1,2,3

Side-by-side spec comparison with aggregated standard and optional features

Sample Request / Payload
Query params: ?ids=1,3,7
GET/api/upcoming?bodyType=SUV

Fetches directly from PostgreSQL v_upcoming_launches view with days-until-launch countdown

Sample Request / Payload
Query params: ?bodyType=SUV&manufacturer=Tata
POST / PUT / DELETE/api/admin/cars

CRUD operations with parameterized SQL DML statements, auto-embedding, and soft/hard deletes

Sample Request / Payload
{
  "modelId": 1,
  "variantName": "Fearless Plus Red Dark Edition",
  "price": 1520000,
  "fuelType": "Petrol",
  "transmission": "DCT",
  "safetyRating": 5,
  "featureIds": [
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4
  ]
}
Database connected via process.env.DATABASE_URL with pgvector(1536)
